name: bunny
//: How the drawing is turned into dots. gate is how much the brightness has to change from one dot to the next to count as a line; thick is the stroke it is drawn at, per height. See cmd/spindle-figures.
//head: The share of the figure the head is looked for in, from the top. face is how much of that head is cleared for a face to be drawn into; at nought the head is left exactly as it was drawn, which is what a figure with a face of its own wants.
//bob: How far he rises and falls as he goes, in dots. A hop is not in the drawing: a rabbit in mid air over the same patch of floor is a rabbit standing on its toes.
